lines.direction: a cheerful old shopkeeper, genuinely pleased to see a customer, warm and a little sly

lines.text: My knees are not what they were.
lines.direction: rueful and self-mocking, rubbing a sore knee, a tired sigh in it

lines.text: Bring me a potion and I'll make it worth your while.
lines.direction: leaning in, conspiratorial, making a deal he thinks is generous
delighted and surprised, a little laugh of pleasure

lines.text: Here, thirty rounds, on the house.
lines.direction: warm and generous, handing them over, pleased with himself
satisfied, a merchant counting his coins, brisk
fond and fatherly, a gentle warning, seeing a regular off
